context: Patient, 24, graduate student. Referred for exam-related anxiety and poor sleep. Doctor wants to track anxiety, sleep, mood and social isolation across sessions.
messages: Hi, I had an okay day. A bit of studying and a walk with my friends.
I'm a little worried about the exam next week but I think I can handle it.
I slept fine, I was tired though after the library.
Honestly I'm more stressed this week. My mind keeps racing about the deadline.
I stayed awake until 3am again, I couldn't stop worrying about the exam.
I cancelled on my friends again. I just want to avoid everyone, I feel so anxious around people.
I'm exhausted, I barely sleep and I feel overwhelmed and kind of empty.
Nothing feels worth it, I feel alone and like a burden to everybody.
